title: Hopfield Networks is All You Need
summary_zh: 將現代 Hopfield 網路推廣到連續狀態，提出新的能量函數與更新規則，證明其指數級儲存容量（隨關聯空間維度呈 $c^{(d-1)/4}$）、單步檢索與指數級小的檢索誤差。關鍵洞見：這條更新規則恰好等同於 Transformer 的注意力機制，使注意力可被理解為關聯記憶的一次檢索，並據此將 BERT 各層的注意力頭依其「亞穩態」大小分類。將此記憶封裝為三種即插即用的 Hopfield 層，在免疫組庫分類（約 30 萬 instances）與多個小型分類基準上刷新 state-of-the-art。
summary_en: Generalizes modern Hopfield networks to continuous states with a new energy function and update rule, proving exponential storage capacity (scaling as $c^{(d-1)/4}$ in the associative-space dimension), one-step retrieval, and exponentially small retrieval error. The central result: this update rule is exactly the attention mechanism of the transformer, recasting attention as a single associative-memory retrieval and letting the paper classify BERT attention heads by the size of their ‘metastable’ states. Packaged as three drop-in Hopfield layers, it set state-of-the-art on immune-repertoire classification (~300k instances) and several small classification benchmarks.
